# metapp

[![](https://zenodo.org/badge/DOI/10.5281/zenodo.21913236.svg)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21913236)

**NOTE: This package should be used for internal purposes only at the
moment.**

## Overview

A Helper Package for Recalculating Effect Sizes in Meta-Analyses.

## Background

Meta-Analyses quantify and combine effects in the published scientific
literature. Different ways exist to calculate an effect size (and its
uncertainty) for a single scientific study. This packages provides
various effect size calculation methods for group differences.

## Installation

Install `metapp` from GitHub:

``` r

if (!require(remotes)) install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("smnnlt/metapp")
```

## Usage

``` r

library(metapp)

# calculate a SMD with Hedges correction for small sample bias
smd(x1 = 5, x2 = 7, sd1 = 2, sd2 = 3, n1 = 20, n2 = 18)
#>           es       var
#> 1 -0.7763268 0.1134856
```

# Package index

## Calculate Effect Sizes

- [`md()`](https://smnnlt.github.io/metapp/reference/md.md) :
  Calculating a mean difference
- [`smd()`](https://smnnlt.github.io/metapp/reference/smd.md) :
  Calculating a standardized mean difference
- [`ppc()`](https://smnnlt.github.io/metapp/reference/ppc.md) :
  Calculating a standardized change score difference (raw score based
  standardization)
- [`smcr()`](https://smnnlt.github.io/metapp/reference/smcr.md) :
  Calculating a standardized change score (raw score based
  standardization)

## Calculate Confidence Intervals

- [`get_ci()`](https://smnnlt.github.io/metapp/reference/get_ci.md) :
  Get the confidence interval for a given effect size

## Helpers

- [`pool_groups()`](https://smnnlt.github.io/metapp/reference/pool_groups.md)
  : Pool groups
- [`j()`](https://smnnlt.github.io/metapp/reference/j.md) : Calculating
  the Hedges correction factor
- [`sd_pooled()`](https://smnnlt.github.io/metapp/reference/sd_pooled.md)
  : Calculate pooled standard deviation
- [`sd_avg()`](https://smnnlt.github.io/metapp/reference/sd_avg.md) :
  Calculate average standard deviation
- [`r_to_sdd()`](https://smnnlt.github.io/metapp/reference/r_to_sdd.md)
  : Get change score standard deviation from pre-post correlation
- [`sdd_to_r()`](https://smnnlt.github.io/metapp/reference/sdd_to_r.md)
  : Get pre-post correlation from change score standard deviation
